Title: Service Bus US Government resource GUID and naming impacts

Body.Content:
On June 1, 2019, the resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) and meter names for Azure Service Bus will change. Pricing will not be affected. Global and US DoD resource GUIDs will break out into US Government regions. EA customers will experience product name changes. Also, "Premium" will be added to the naming of the US DoD Messaging Unit resource GUIDs.

See the following table for all naming and resource GUID changes.
